description: This file defines the AzureApi class, a specialized extension of OpenAIApi, providing methods to configure and interact with Azure OpenAI services, including URL setup, message filtering, and streaming chat completions.

classes.name: AzureApi
classes.description: A class extending OpenAIApi to interface with Azure-specific OpenAI endpoints, handling URL configuration, message filtering, and streaming chat completions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes AzureApi with configuration, setting up the OpenAI client with Azure-specific URL and parameters.

methods.name: _isAzureOpenAI
methods.description: Checks if the API type is 'azure-openai' or 'azure', indicating Azure OpenAI usage.

methods.name: _getAzureBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs the base URL and default query parameters for Azure OpenAI, including handling deployment and API version.

methods.name: _filterEmptyContentParts
methods.description: Removes empty or whitespace-only text parts from message contents to ensure compatibility with Azure models.

methods.name: modifyChatBody
methods.description: Overrides parent method to filter out empty content parts from chat message bodies.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from Azure OpenAI, filtering out chunks with no choices.
